_healthy: A scenario is fixed only if, after the code fix and a rebuild, the re-run shows no wait cycle / chain in pidin AND the listed loop roles keep printing TICKs.

D01.fix: do not MsgSend to a peer that sends to you: notify with MsgSendPulse (or receive on a separate thread)

D02.fix: pass work with MsgSendPulse (or receive on a separate thread) so a stage never waits for the next one

D03.states: server SEND-blocked on logger, logger SEND-blocked on server, client hangs behind
D03.fix: logger reports status with MsgSendPulse instead of a blocking MsgSend

D04.states: client REPLY-blocked on server, server SEND-blocked on client
D04.fix: reply first, then notify the client with MsgSendPulse (never a synchronous callback to a client waiting for your reply)

D05.states: high-priority control REPLY-blocked on a READY low-priority server while middle-priority hogs run
D05.fix: create the channel without _NTO_CHF_FIXED_PRIORITY so the server inherits the client's priority

D06.states: client REPLY-blocked on a server that is sleeping on purpose; not a fault

D07.states: idle workers RECEIVE-blocked waiting for pulses; not a fault
